rules.skinToneRule: Skin tone and ethnicity are baked into each portrait asset. Never recolor skin at render time.
rules.genderRule: Portrait assets are gender-specific. Female fighters never use beard overlays.
rules.identityRule: Elite portraits are personality-weighted finished faces; lower tiers share one same-art-style base portrait per family and gender.
rules.hairColorRule: Hair color is baked into curated faces; unusual elite looks such as pink, platinum and white hair are allowed.
